namespace.description: The namespace in which the should be created.

tenantName.description: The tenant name to apply to the gateway.

idpHost.description: The IDP hostname to use in the gateway.

enabled.description: Whether the Authentication Gateway prerequisite should be installed.

nameOverride.description: String to partially override fullname (will maintain the release name).

fullnameOverride.description: String to fully override the generated release name.

namespace.description: The namespace in which to deploy OpenSearch. If not set, defaults to the release namespace.

existingCredentialName.description: The name of an existing secret containing TLS credentials.

key.description: The TLS key to apply to a secret. Ignored when `tls.existingCredentialName` is set.

crt.description: The TLS crt to apply to a secret. Ignored when `tls.existingCredentialName` is set.

istio.description: The Istio ingress selector label to target.
